0x000894.en: 「At my current skill level...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x00098D.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000AB6.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000AEE.en: 「Oh dear...@ how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B62.en: 「Grrh, this is as far as I go!」

0x000BB7.en: 「Tch! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000BF2.en: 「As if I'd screw up here, of all places...!@ This is no fun...」

0x000C46.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CBA.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D30.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D97.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is on you.」

0x000E43.en: 「No good, took too many hits... falling back!」

0x000E90.en: 「I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000ECE.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F15.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FC0.en: 「Ngh... so I'm the falling star this time... I'm ejecting!」

0x0011B0.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x0011E5.en: 「Dammit! Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x0012D1.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ How green of me...!」

0x00131F.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x001447.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001476.en: 「I can't do any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x001501.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001725.en: 「Nnghh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001865.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x001894.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0018F5.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x0019DF.en: 「The Federation force is engaged with the Ruina near the north magnetic pole@ and is pinned down. All units are clear@ of our present course.」

0x001A8D.en: 「However, the Gaia Sabers' Air Christmas has entered@ the north magnetic pole region...@ and appears to be fighting the Ruina.」

0x001B3C.en: 「So they used the Federation force as a decoy, did they?」

0x001B7F.en: 「Like the Hagane, the Air Christmas is a ship@ built on the ISA framework, I believe.」

0x001BF9.en: 「Weren't they planning a blitz using that capability from the start?」

0x001C55.en: 「At worst, we'll have a three-way fight.@ Captain, shall we slow down and watch?」

0x001CB7.en: 「No. Lee Linjun isn't foolish enough to@ move against us in this situation.@ We'll press on into the north magnetic pole.」

0x001DBD.en: 「Y-yes, ma'am!@ The instant they touched the barrier, they vanished!」

0x001E0A.en: 「All units, concentrate fire again!@ Relay the order to Alpha and Gamma squads too!」

0x001E6F.en: 「Ma'am!@ Saber 1 to all Alpha, Gamma units!@ Commence attack on the target!」

0x001F0E.en: 「You all heard her. We're moving in!」

0x002015.en: 「No good! We can't break the barrier!」

0x00206F.en: 「Tch, there's only three of 'em and we can't touch 'em!」

0x0020BC.en: 「It is futile, humans.@ The Septemplum cannot be broken.」

0x002118.en: 「Now, raise your cries of resentment. They sustain@ the Atrum Exterior, and through the Ventos become@ offerings to the King of Ruin.」

0x0021E5.en: 「Ugh, this is so frustrating!@ There's no way to earn any glory here!」

0x002259.en: 「I hate the cold. I want to go home already.」

0x0022CB.en: 「That barrier resembles a dimensional rift.@ Even a nuke couldn't break it.」

0x002345.en: 「Colonel Carly,@ shouldn't we pull back for now?」

0x00239B.en: 「After coming this far, how could I!?@ The Gaia Sabers' pride is on the line!」

0x002424.en: 「If it were me, I'd send in my troops here.@ Best way to torment them.」

0x002523.en: 「What...?@ You can sense that, inside this Septemplum?」

0x0025ED.en: 「Hiryu Kai, closing in! Straight on from three o'clock!」

0x0026AC.en: (His thoughts aren't being blocked@ by the Septemplum...!?)

0x002702.en: (Is he shaken? And the way the sync gauge@ is fluctuating like this...@ it's different from last time...!)

0x00280C.en: (There were times her condition went haywire@ when we fought the Melior Esse, but@ this is... this is something else...!)

0x0028D9.en: 「The Hiryu, coming all the way out here...!」

0x002913.en: 「Oh my, a stalemate against all expectations?@ If this turns three-way, the odds get so bad@ it deserves a round of applause.」

0x0029B9.en: 「Oh dear.@ Then a round of applause for that cool correction.」

0x002A0C.en: 「Just as the Captain said, the Gaia Sabers@ don't seem inclined to attack us.」

0x002AC4.en: 「Medius Locus...!@ Mitarl, so that's your game.」

0x002B1A.en: 「Then making us fight our own machines was...!」

0x002B5A.en: 「Not a mock battle. The goal was to gather combat data@ on TE Absorbers pitted against each other in real combat.」

0x002BE3.en: 「And if a machine broke, or worst case@ a pilot died...」

0x002C45.en: 「That was likely of no great concern to him.」

0x002C85.en: (...Exactly the sort of thing that man would scheme.@ But data like that could have been gathered@ within the Gaia Sabers if he'd wanted.)

0x002D3F.en: (So why choose us, Federation soldiers, as pilots@ and second us to the Instructor Corps?)

0x002DBF.en: 「...So now those two have caught on to@ Mitarl's scheme, and yours.」

0x002E1B.en: 「Whatever those men hunted by the Federation might say,@ we can handle it however we please.@ Justice is on our side, is it not?」

0x002EC0.en: 「...All hands, this is an order.@ We are withdrawing from this combat zone for now.」

0x002F23.en: 「You mean run from here!?@ What about the barrier and the Steel Dragons!?」

0x002FAA.en: 「That may be fine for you,@ but we want some glory here!」

0x003012.en: 「So we won't have to fight Lieutenant Hugo and the others...@ Is that it, Major Albero?」

0x003093.en: 「If you say so, that's fine.@ Even former subordinates can't compare@ to the love one holds for one's own child.」

0x003120.en: 「...All units, this is a direct order from Commander Alteur.@ We are pulling back for now.」

0x00318B.en: 「So we leave the Unknowns to the Steel Dragons.」

0x0031DA.en: 「Then we hit 'em once they're worn down...@ Yeah, that's the tastier deal.」

0x003248.en: 「I'm fine heading home. I hate the cold.」

0x00328B.en: 「Deploy a barrage forward! We're pulling back!」

0x003312.en: (Hugo... survive this by your own strength.)

0x00339C.en: 「Those guys@ dumped the Ruina on us and bolted!」

0x0033F2.en: 「No, they're after the spoils. Even if we wipe out@ the Septemplum, that bunch will come at us.」

0x003488.en: 「Worst case, they could shoot us in the back@ while we're fighting the Ruina.」

0x003513.en: 「That Gaia Sabers attack just now revealed something -@ the Septemplum's barrier works@ a lot like the dimensional rift.」

0x0035D6.en: 「So a normal attack won't break it, huh...」

0x00361F.en: 「Right. And just so we're clear,@ charging in with the Excellence@ won't do any good either.」

0x0036C3.en: 「But unlike the dimensional rift,@　we can see inside that barrier...」

0x003787.en: 「It means that barrier might resemble the rift@　but not truly be one. Which means@　there may be a way to break through it.」

0x003838.en: 「Ruina up front, Gaia Sabers at our back...@ and no sure way to crack that barrier on top of it.@ This is one lousy bet, that's for sure...」

0x0038F8.en: 「Same as always. Can't say I hate it, though.」

0x00392C.en: 「...Even with that barrier, I can still feel@　Glacies' thoughts. Which means it isn't@　shutting out everything...」

0x0039E0.en: 「Right. The Melior Esse seem able to pass@　in and out, and if we can see inside,@　then it's letting light through.」

0x003A85.en: 「Get closer and we might get some reaction...@　Might be able to change this whole situation.」

0x003AFC.en: 「That's just wishful thinking... and you'd be@　the one taking on the greatest risk.」

0x003B67.en: 「Wipe out the dimensional rift...@　or even just find a clue to how. That'd be enough.」

0x003BCF.en: 「Bad odds or not, nothing happens@　unless we try.」

0x003C25.en: 「If Joshie's set on it, then we'll@　back him up with everything we've got.」

0x003C81.en: 「We'll clear you a path.@　You focus on making contact with the Melior Esse.」

0x003CDD.en: 「Understood.@　...Lim, you take up the rear guard.」

0x003D30.en: 「What's wrong, Lim?@　Don't tell me your Sympathia's acting up too...」

0x003DC3.en: （L-Liana... this feeling...@　I bet it's one of the machines@　over there causing it...）

0x003E4A.en: （Yeah... let's try getting closer.@　Like Bro said, we might get a reaction.）

0x003EDD.en: （We've got no choice, not in this spot.@　If Bro's heading for Glacies,@　then I'll head over there too.）

0x00404D.en: （Eek, who's there!? Liana, who is this!?）

0x0040C1.en: 「Noise in the Sympathia...!@　But it's different from any of the others!」

0x004148.en: （You... who are you? Why do you call me...?）

0x004185.en: （I don't know you! I don't know you at all!）

0x0041BC.en: （Why do you enter my mind...?@　The other one doesn't, and yet...）

0x00426D.en: (Cliss and Liana... so those are your names...)

0x0042A1.en: （H-how do you know that!?@　I never told you my name!）

0x00431F.en: (To me... it feels like it can only be you,@ the two of you, pulling me in...)

0x004381.en: （No, Liana! I hate this! What is this!?）

0x0043ED.en: 「The Septemplum is wavering...@　What are you doing, Ventos?」

0x004483.en: 「What? Don't tell me you too, with that human...」

0x004524.en: （Is this noise the backlash from Lim and him!?@　Well, Glacies!?）

0x004598.en: （Ngh, are you saying the connection@　is easier than last time...?）

0x0045EE.en: （...Why do you two try to disturb me...?）

0x00466E.en: （Yes... I am the first Melior Esse.@　But you, the girl with two souls...）

0x00470D.en: （I don't understand what's happening either...@　But you mustn't fear. You mustn't be afraid.@　You mustn't hate...）

0x0047B8.en: （For those are what the King of Ruin seeks.）

0x004811.en: 「Cease, Ventos.@　The Septemplum's power is weakening.」

0x00486A.en: 「Stay there, supply the sustenance,@　and maintain the Atrum Exterior.@　That is why you were created.」

0x00497A.en: 「Could it be that, like Josh and Glacies,@　you too are with a Melior Esse...?」

0x004A32.en: 「Unlike with Glacies, I felt no thoughts.@　But that one... it seemed different@　from the other Melior Esse...」

0x004AED.en: 「...Can you hear me, Josh.@　A moment ago, a wavering phenomenon@　was observed on the Septemplum's surface.」

0x004B80.en: 「The timing matches as well.@　It's highly likely this was the result@　of interference from the Sympathia.」

0x004C19.en: 「So if we keep closing in, our odds@　in this bet go up, is that it?」

0x004C72.en: 「Though it may be Lim, not you.」

0x004CAC.en: （Even I don't know what'll happen if I get close...@　And now Lim too...）

0x004D55.en: 「Bro... I'm going.@　We might be able to do something@　about the Septemplum, right?」

0x004DEC.en: 「I'm sick of a sky with no sun or stars.@　Bad bet or not, I'm in it with you, Bro.」

0x004E76.en: 「Then let's look after the both of you together.」

0x004F1E.en: 「...Still you defy us.@　Any further interference may be dangerous.@　I shall go forth.」

0x004FA0.en: 「No, you stay there.@　It seems I am the only one who can@　remain free of their influence.」

0x00502A.en: 「The problem lies not on our side,@　but with the system on theirs...」

0x00508C.en: 「By human tampering, it may be manifesting@　powers none could have foreseen.」

0x0051C2.en: 「So it's inconvenient for them if the Aile@　Chevalier and the Blanche Neige@　get too close, then.」

0x00526E.en: 「...Hear me, human.@　I am the Melior Esse, Umbra.@　The shadow of darkness that brings death.」

0x0052FF.en: 「Of all the Melior Esse we've met so far,@　that's the least human of the lot...」

0x00536D.en: 「Can't even tell if it's male or female...」

0x00542D.en: 「Through the Atrum Exterior, this world@ fills with dark waves, and that draws@ the King of Ruin. I won't allow interference.」

0x005577.en: 「Yeah, we heard it at the South Pole.」

0x00559C.en: 「Leave Umbra to us,@　and you head for the Septemplum.」

0x005604.en: 「Understood.@　...Lim, be careful until we make contact@　with that Melior Esse. Avoid fighting, don't waste shots.」

0x0056BF.en: （Liana, you know where we're headed, right?）

0x00572A.en: 「You who are fated for ruin...@　be wrapped in the dark of hatred and pain, and perish.」

0x005798.en: 「Umbra... no way around you, is there!」

0x0057CF.en: （Noise is arising...@　but my systems show no real anomaly.）

0x00586E.en: （It's the same as the other Melior Esse...@　just the Sympathia acting up...）

0x005925.en: （Contact made it clear... this human, could it be...）

0x00597E.en: 「Lim, don't fight carelessly!@　There's no telling what'll happen after!」

0x005A8F.en: 「Human, so you'll resist to the very end...」

0x005B21.en: 「What'll this do... what's going to happen...!?」

0x005C86.en: （Your machine... and its system...@　that's what binds us together...）

0x005D22.en: （Our minds... our feelings...@　forced into resonance, drawing each other in...!）

0x005D90.en: （Uugh, I can't stop it... it's breaking apart...!）

0x005F37.en: 「What... to think such a thing could happen...」

0x005F87.en: （I-I'm being sucked in!! I can't escape!!）

0x006005.en: （S-space...!?@　Where did big brother and everyone go!?）

0x006061.en: （We were flung out of the Septemplum...@　and fell into the rift between dimensions...?）

0x00612E.en: （We did, to be exact.@　The force pulling us together drew you into the Septemplum...@　and the Atrum Exterior...）

0x0061DF.en: （So I opened the gate...@　But why... do we resonate and draw together...?）

0x006247.en: （What happened to Earth... to Bro and the others!?）

0x0062B9.en: （What I do know is... you were the first@　to touch the system...）

0x006343.en: （You call it the Sympathia, don't you.）

0x0063C4.en: （You came to have two souls...@　am I wrong?）

0x006421.en: （Which of you is the real you... that is...）

0x00645E.en: （B-both of us are me!@　Me and Cliss both, we're Cliana Rimskaya!!）

0x0064CF.en: （I can tell... I can see...@　why you call me, though why our minds@　resonate I don't know... but you...）

0x00659C.en: （Ventos!@　Say one more word and I swear I'll...!!）

0x0065F5.en: （I still... have a role to play...）

0x006692.en: （It's breaking apart again...! But this is...!!）

0x0067DE.en: （That below us... that's Earth, isn't it...?）

0x006818.en: 「Could it be that the Artrum Exterior has...!」

0x00692F.en: 「Why is it all the way out here, alone...?」

0x006966.en: 「Maybe it's got something to do@ with the dimensional rift vanishing...」

0x0069BF.en: 「Either way, let's recover the Blanche Neige.@ And Azuki... try to open a channel@ with the Hiryu Kai.」

0x006A59.en: （Just what happened down on the surface...?）

0x006AD7.en: 「Yes...@ I'm glad everyone on the Hagane is safe too...」

0x006B27.en: 「We got thrown outside the dimensional rift...@ into a space where Earth had vanished.」

0x006B89.en: 「After that, the Gaia Sabers came after us,@ and we fought the Guests invading the moon.」

0x006C37.en: 「The Space Force and Guests are at war.@ The Ruina appeared in space too,@ and seized the Heaven's Gate.」

0x006CE6.en: 「But the Guests attacked the Heaven's Gate...@ and the Melior Esse pulled back toward Earth.」

0x006D63.en: 「So we chased them down, and while we were@ fighting in the skies near the North Pole,@ that phenomenon happened.」

0x006DE7.en: 「Just what happened on the surface? Explain.」

0x006E2D.en: 「The Artrum Exterior... the dimensional rift@ blocked out the sun and stars, and the world@ was sealed in darkness.」

0x006EC2.en: 「We were hunted by the Federation and the@ Gaia Sabers, fighting the Ruina...」

0x006F27.en: 「And in the middle of it, my brother@ linked minds with Glacies...」

0x006FAE.en: 「She's a female Melior Esse...@ Through the Sympathia, my brother saw@ into that person's heart...」

0x00706C.en: 「...That's similar to the mutual thought-sensing@ of the <T-LINK System>.」

0x0070CD.en: 「But Josh has no psychic power...@ Lim, what about you?」

0x00713E.en: 「For me... it was no different from@ fighting any other Melior Esse...」

0x0071A3.en: 「And then we learned the Ruina had raised@ a Septemplum... a barrier... at the North@ Magnetic Pole...」

0x007233.en: 「Could that Septemplum have been@ the entrance to the dimensional rift?」

0x00729E.en: 「I don't know about that, but Ventos said@ the Septemplum was meant to sustain@ the Artrum Exterior...」

0x00734F.en: 「Ventos... is that a Melior Esse too?」

0x0073F1.en: 「Not just us, but the Federation and the@ Gaia Sabers too... We knew the Ruina's@ forces were massing around it...」

0x0074AB.en: 「So then... why did the dimensional rift vanish?」

0x0074E8.en: 「Just like my brother and Glacies...@ I linked with Ventos through the@ Sympathia too...」

0x007596.en: 「I was pulled inside the Septemplum...@ then flung back out... and Ventos@ took the Artrum Exterior...」

0x007660.en: 「I-I don't understand it either...@ Next thing I knew, I was in space... and I could see Earth...」

0x0076DD.en: 「What that was, I can't say...@ Ventos looked at me... and I...」

0x00777A.en: （B-but Ventos realized@ there were two of us...）

0x007820.en: （I don't get it either.@ ...Anyway, let's just calm down, okay?）

0x0078C0.en: 「Yeah, understood.@ Lim, get checked out in the medical room@ just in case, then rest.」

0x007938.en: 「...So two Melior Esse, Lim and Ventos,@ underwent a mutual psychic resonance,@ and the dimensional rift vanished as a result?」

0x0079DD.en: 「But for something that huge to just@ disappear from a trigger like that...」

0x007A57.en: 「Ventos and the Septemplum were the keyhole@ of the rift, and Lim and the Sympathia@ may have been the key to an unseen door.」

0x007B08.en: 「And that was a fact even the Ruina@ hadn't anticipated...」

0x007B64.en: 「Yeah. Better to think it wasn't Lim who@ opened the door, but Ventos who opened it.」

0x007BF3.en: 「It seems the Sympathia holds a power@ that not just we, but even the Ruina,@ couldn't have foreseen.」

0x007C80.en: 「And Josh and Lim, who wield it,@ may have something to them as well.」

0x007CE2.en: 「Whether it's a trait they were born with, or@ something gained by contact with the Sympathia,@ I couldn't say...」

0x007D7E.en: 「...Captain, we've made contact with the Hiryu Kai.@ They're currently over the Beaufort Sea, at the North Pole.」

0x007E07.en: 「I see... what are they telling us?」

0x007E47.en: 「To descend to Earth and rendezvous.@ They've designated a point as well.」

0x007EA9.en: 「All right, shift to atmospheric reentry sequence.@ We drop to Earth and join up with the Hiryu Kai.」

0x007F36.en: 「Man, for a while there I thought we were done for.@ Well, the Artrum Exterior's gone too,@ so all's well that ends well.」

0x00800F.en: 「Yeah, sorry for worrying you.@ Axel and Alfimi joined up with@ your side, right?」

0x0080D1.en: 「Alfimi said she was going to sleep and left...@ and Captain Axel got off the ship alone@ after the Hagane descended to Earth.」

0x008185.en: 「Without so much as a goodbye to us?@ Geez, what a shy guy.」

0x008218.en: 「The Kurogane.@ The Soulgain's stowed aboard that ship.」

0x0082FC.en: 「That kid who bought yakisoba off me in Asakusa a while back?」

0x008364.en: 「Yeah, yeah.@ It's rare for a customer to buy up every last one@ off the griddle... that's how I remembered you.」

0x0083F4.en: 「Now that you mention it, something like that did happen...」

0x00843D.en: 「I'm Touma Kanou...@ a part-timer at the L&E Corporation.」

0x0084CE.en: 「We've got Touma helping out with@ Excellence Rescue maintenance. All those@ part-time jobs made him pretty handy.」

0x008588.en: 「And he does the cleaning quick too...@ he's a real help to us.」

0x0086B7.en: 「Right, let me introduce her to everyone.@ ...Irui, come over here.」

0x008720.en: 「She's the girl we rescued when@ Commodine Island was attacked by Jinrai.」

0x008785.en: 「But she'd lost her memory...@ one thing led to another, and we're looking after her on the Hiryu.」

0x0087FC.en: 「Lost her past memories... then she's the same as me.」

0x008887.en: 「Irui, could it be...@ do you recognize Ing?」

0x00894D.en: 「By the way, you said you were attacked by Jinrai.@ Was he after the Double G again?」

0x0089D3.en: 「Yes...@ Major Gilliam and the others suspect it@ may belong to the Gaia Sabers.」

0x008A63.en: 「Also, among the Gaia Sabers unit we met@ at the North Pole, there were a Medius Locus and a Kerberion.」

0x008AEF.en: 「At this rate...@ we're bound to clash with them, no question.」

0x008B57.en: 「And the Medius Locus...@ looks like the story about it being stolen was a lie.」

0x008BC5.en: 「Yeah... the Zentral Project was under@ Gaia Sabers control long before@ I ever joined it.」

0x008C58.en: 「Hugo and I were never told about that...」

0x008D18.en: 「I'd like to confirm with Mitarl Zapad, but...@ if we make contact carelessly, they'll learn@ our position and movements.」

0x008DCD.en: 「They're an even deeper den of monsters@ than I'd heard, these Gaia Sabers...」

0x008E2C.en: 「Oh my, Dr. Radom... it's been a while.」

0x008E63.en: 「You were aboard the Hagane too, Doctor?」

0x008EA3.en: 「Yes. I left the Mao Industries plant on the moon@ with Radha, and joined up en route to the L4 region.」

0x008F23.en: 「Don't tell me the Guests hit Mao Industries...?」

0x008F57.en: 「No. Anticipating their attack,@ the president ordered the Exbein parts@ moved to another location.」

0x008FF3.en: 「The Space Force and Guests are fighting on the moon now...@ we can't rule out a repeat of the@ <Inspector Incident>.」

0x00909A.en: 「...Even with the Artrum Exterior gone,@ we've got a mountain of problems.」

0x00910C.en: 「Over here, we tangled with the Galilnagant@ and the Alles Geist in space.」

0x009190.en: 「The true name of the code "Evil" that@ destroyed the Huckebein series.」

0x0091FB.en: 「The pilot's the Gaia Sabers' Omega Saber,@ Amara Barton...@ she went after Ing again.」

0x0092A0.en: 「Also, during the fight with the Alles Geist,@ the Persoenlichkeit's core appeared and@ resonated with the Fau Kern... it activated.」

0x009373.en: 「Yes. The Fau Kern's output limit rose,@ unlocking its latent power. That let@ the Flickerei access new weapons...」

0x00944B.en: 「Duvan tried to seize the Persoenlichkeit's core@ to gain even greater power.」

0x0094CE.en: 「The Alles Geist has Jetzt biological@ components built into it... and if he got@ his hands on something like that as well...」

0x00956A.en: 「...Worst case, it could turn into a Jetzt.」

0x0095DE.en: 「Yeah... she noticed the thing about us...@ asked which of us was the real one...」

0x00965C.en: 「And then... for it to end up like that...@ maybe one of us is...」

0x0096EF.en: 「...If that's so, then how do you explain@ Josh, or the professor? They touched@ the Sympathia too.」

0x009791.en: 「But we were the first ones to...@ I don't remember it well... I don't know...」

0x0097FC.en: 「Me neither...@ But which of us is real doesn't matter anymore...」

0x00984C.en: 「We are... yes, me and Riana together,@ we're Cliana Rimskaya...」

0x0098D3.en: 「...Chris is right. You two are my precious family...@ Not sharing blood, which one's real, none of@ that matters.」

0x00998D.en: 「Chris and Riana both... you're my dear sisters.」

0x0099E3.en: (...Josh and Glacies...@ Lim and Ventos... these pairings...)

0x009A5A.en: （The key to unraveling all these mysteries@ really is the Sympathia...）

0x009AEA.en: 「Yes... we ran into him on the way to the North Pole.@ He called himself Carly Nauman, and was@ captain of the Air Christmas.」

0x009BA1.en: 「That man's alive, and with the Gaia Sabers...」

0x009BE7.en: 「That's not all.@ One of the Machinery Children,@ Egret Urd, was there too.」

0x009CAB.en: 「...Ariel, I called you here because@ there's something about the Gaia Sabers@ I wanted to confirm.」

0x009D44.en: 「Did you know about the Egret Urd matter?」

0x009DA0.en: 「He called himself Egretta Uno.@ Does that ring a bell?」

0x009DFF.en: 「It does...@ He's the captain of the Gaia Sabers' Alpha Saber.」

0x009E61.en: 「Alpha's a unit shrouded in mystery...@ I've glimpsed its members, but they all@ wear masks, and aside from Egretta they're silent...」

0x009F12.en: 「There were even rumors they were androids...@ To think they were the Machinery Children...」

0x009FA1.en: 「Colonel Lefina, what's our plan going forward?」

0x009FE1.en: 「We've been stripped of rank, but under orders from@ Lt. Gen. Jacob Moore of Intelligence, we're now an@ unofficial independent strike force.」

0x00A0B0.en: 「That said, outwardly nothing's changed...@ we'll still be pursued by the Federation@ and the Gaia Sabers.」

0x00A143.en: 「We've only just come off a fierce battle,@ so I'd like to repair and resupply somewhere...」

0x00A1B4.en: 「Then head for Itiiti Island in the South Pacific.@ It looks uninhabited, but we have a base there.@ We can lie low.」

0x00A25C.en: 「Understood.@ Then let's make for Itiiti Island.」

0x00A2E2.en: 「What in the world is going on?@ For the Artrum Exterior to just@ vanish like that...」

0x00A366.en: 「To think that human, that system,@　could interfere with the Septemplum in such a way...」

0x00A3F0.en: 「True, it was something we could not foresee.」

0x00A427.en: 「Those who bring dysfunction to Glacies and@　Ventos... Humans and Melior Esse, beings that@　should never mix... Why do they resonate?」

0x00A50D.en: 「Never mind Laki, Ventos failed. The Artorum@　Exterior wasn't broken through, he opened it@　himself.」

0x00A5C1.en: 「You. What were you doing? Have you forgotten@　your role? Do you understand why we take on@　the dirty work?」

0x00A669.en: 「Why it turned out that way... whether I@　resonated with them... I don't understand it@　either...」

0x00A6F9.en: 「It is beyond me as well...@　Do not blame Ventos.」

0x00A74C.en: 「Then hurry and use the Artorum Exterior...」

0x00A798.en: 「That requires great power. Deploy it again@　and the Lord of Ruin's awakening will be@　delayed.」

0x00A81C.en: 「Besides, those humans could cause the same@　thing to happen once more.」

0x00A887.en: 「Better to build an Officinas on the surface@ and bolster our forces.」

0x00A8F3.en: 「Contagio and I found a site for an Officinas@　in space. If Ventos hadn't failed, by now@　we'd have...」

0x00A99B.en: 「Leave space for now. More urgently, destroy@　those humans and their system. Before they@　bring us further trouble.」

0x00AA40.en: 「Got it.@ Laki, leave them to me.」
